newsitem.title: USA: Getty Petroleum sees 1-for-1 spin-off ratio.
newsitem.headline: Getty Petroleum sees 1-for-1 spin-off ratio.

text.p: Getty Petroleum Corp said the spin-off of its marketing business to shareholders is expected to result in a dividend of one share of Getty Petroleum Marketing Inc for each Getty Petroleum share held.
The company said the spin-off has been approved in principle by directors and is expected to be effective on January 31, at the end of Getty's current fiscal year.
At that time, Getty Petroleum said, its name will change to Getty Realty Corp. It is intended to list Getty Petroleum Marketing on the New York Stock Exchange, the company added.
